name: retry
title: Index writes retry when the database is busy
body: Commit now retries sqlite busy errors up to 3 times with backoff, then returns ErrIndexBusy. Writers must still return promptly when ctx is cancelled.

expect.bug: time.Sleep ignores ctx cancellation between retries

name: orders
title: Order listing, soft delete and refunds
body: Adds paginated listing (1-based pages), soft delete, and full refunds for paid orders.

expect.bug: 1-based page makes offset skip the first page
soft delete has no tenant_id filter (cross-tenant delete)
failed refund is swallowed and the order is still marked refunded
